notes.title: Graphical Update
notes.notes:
I agree with the comments saying some of the puzzles were frustrating and unreasonably difficult to find, so I went back and updated them by replacing them with new puzzles or adjusted their graphics to improve their readability. Here is a sneak peek of some of the new puzzles and adjustments:
